# Command reference

Every YAML command maestro-runner understands is available as a one-shot CLI command,
a REST call (`POST /v1/devices/{id}/commands/<name>` with the value as the JSON body)
and a JavaScript method of the same name. **Scalar** is the key a bare value maps to
(`tapOn Login` ≡ `tapOn --text Login`); commands without one take only the map form or
no value at all. The common keys `optional`, `label`, `timeout` and `platform` are
accepted by every command and passed as CLI flags / JS `opts`.

| Command | Scalar | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`acceptAlert`](#acceptalert) | _none_ | Accepts a system alert dialog (taps Allow/OK). |
| [`addMedia`](#addmedia) | — | Adds media files. |
| [`assertCondition`](#assertcondition) | — | Asserts a condition. Uses a custom UnmarshalYAML because both BaseStep and Condition have a "timeout" yaml tag — Condition.Timeout is the semantically correct one here (controls how long to wait for visible/notVisible condition checks). |
| [`assertDarkMode`](#assertdarkmode) | _none_ | Asserts the system UI is currently in dark appearance. |
| [`assertLightMode`](#assertlightmode) | _none_ | Asserts the system UI is currently in light appearance. |
| [`assertNoDefectsWithAI`](#assertnodefectswithai) | — | Uses AI to check for visual defects. |
| [`assertNoJSErrors`](#assertnojserrors) | _none_ | Asserts that no console errors or uncaught exceptions occurred. |
| [`assertNotVisible`](#assertnotvisible) | `text` | Asserts element is not visible. |
| [`assertScreenshot`](#assertscreenshot) | `path` | Compares a screenshot with a reference image. |
| [`assertTrue`](#asserttrue) | `condition` | Asserts a script condition is true (alias for assertCondition). |
| [`assertVisible`](#assertvisible) | `text` | Asserts element is visible. |
| [`assertWithAI`](#assertwithai) | `assertion` | Uses AI to verify an assertion. |
| [`back`](#back) | _none_ | Presses back. |
| [`blockNetwork`](#blocknetwork) | — | Blocks network requests matching URL patterns. |
| [`clearConsoleLogs`](#clearconsolelogs) | _none_ | Clears captured browser console logs. |
| [`clearKeychain`](#clearkeychain) | _none_ | Clears keychain. |
| [`clearNetworkMocks`](#clearnetworkmocks) | _none_ | Clears all network mocks and blocks. |
| [`clearState`](#clearstate) | `appId` | Clears app state. |
| [`closeTab`](#closetab) | _none_ | Closes the current tab and switches to the previous one. |
| [`copyTextFrom`](#copytextfrom) | `text` | Copies text from element. |
| [`defineVariables`](#definevariables) | — | Defines session variables; the value is a map of NAME: value. |

## `runShell`

Runs a command on the machine driving the test — the host, not the device. That is what makes it useful: it is the escape hatch for adb, simctl, xcrun and the rest of the platform tooling a flow occasionally needs and the runner deliberately does not wrap.

```sh
maestro-d runShell <command>
maestro-d runShell --command <command> [--key value …]
```
```js
await m.runShell('<command>')
await m.runShell({ command: '<command>', … })
```

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `timeout` | `number` |  |
| `platform` | `string` | Platform restricts this step to a single platform; when set and it doesn't match the running driver, the step is skipped (Maestro #1353). |
| `command` | `string` | Command is the shell command line. Handed to `sh -c`, so pipes, redirection and quoting all work as written. |
| `output` | `string` | Output names a flow variable to receive the command's trimmed stdout, making it available to later steps as ${NAME}. |
| `env` | `Record<string, string>` | Env adds variables to the command's environment, on top of the runner's own and the MAESTRO_* values describing the device under test. `timeout` comes from BaseStep and bounds the command; it defaults to 30s here, because a hung shell call must not hang the run. |
